title: Discount Program Rate Card: Entry & Patio Door Contracts
content:
Discount program rates for Entry & Patio Door Contracts are fixed per door series. Each rate is applied to the list price at signing.

| Door series | Military program rate | Senior program rate | First-responder program rate | Senior program minimum age on the signing date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 10% | 5% | 10% | 65 years |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 10% | 5% | 10% | 65 years |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 8% | 5% | 8% | 65 years |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 8% | 4% | 8% | 65 years |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 6% | 4% | 6% | 65 years |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 6% | 4% | 6% | 65 years |

## Definitions

- **Military program rate**: the military discount program rate applied to the list price at signing.
- **Senior program rate**: the senior discount program rate applied to the list price at signing.
- **First-responder program rate**: the first-responder discount program rate applied to the list price at signing.
- **Senior program minimum age**: the minimum age, in whole years on the contract signing date, for the senior program.

## Notes on the card

- In every series the military rate and the first-responder rate are the same figure, and both are higher than the senior rate of that series.
- The senior minimum age is 65 years in every series.
- Hypothetical: on a Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door list price of $6000.00, the military rate of 8% corresponds to $480.00 and the senior rate of 5% to $300.00.
